query:
SELECT c.person_id AS "person_id!"
            FROM unnest($2::bigint[]) AS c(person_id)
            WHERE (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM posthog_persondistinctid d
                    WHERE d.team_id = $1
                      AND d.person_id = c.person_id
                      AND d.is_deleted = false
                    LIMIT $3::bigint + 1
                ) capped
            ) > $3::bigint
